subject: Request: timeboxed discount approval for Nimbus routing gap
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: timeboxed discount approval for Nimbus routing gap

Hi Laura / Monica —

Quick background: Nimbus Analytics (DEAL-8943) is a $420k ARR account currently in legal review for a 12-month contract. They are ready to sign but discovered our smart-routing feature (multi-region affinity + fallback) will not be in GA until late July due to a scheduling shift in runtime prioritization. This creates a risk: their production traffic pattern requires the routing behavior for predictable latency across EU/US and they’ve asked for a billing concession while we finish the rollout.

Customer ask: a one-time, timeboxed discount of 20% for the first two billing months (applied as credits) contingent on us shipping the routing GA by 2027-07-30 and providing a post-launch performance report. They want written assurance before countersigning.

Impact analysis (attached):
- Projected near-term revenue at risk: $35k (risk of either delay or reduced commitment)
- Long-term ARR: $420k if we close now.
- Commercial ask cost (estimated): ~$7k in credits over two months.

Recommendation: provisional approval for the 2-month, 20% credit (credits applied to first two invoices), with the following guardrails:
1) Credits auto-revoke if routing GA slips past 2027-07-30 without notice and a new ETR.
2) Legal to review concession language (see proposed_concession_term.docx).
3) CS to provide a launch validation dashboard within two weeks of GA.

Ask: Can Leadership approve this provisional concession so the AE (Aditya) can secure signature this week? I can attach the short concession clause for legal and loop in Eng for firm ETR.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. GTM Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: timeboxed discount approval for Nimbus routing gap

Rishi — thanks for the write-up, concise and helpful. A few questions before I give provisional sign-off:

1) Revenue protection: what's the downside of delaying signature by two weeks to see if we can get a firmer eng ETA?
2) Legal: is the concession reversible if routing slips? The proposed doc should include an explicit sunset and acceptance criteria.
3) CS/PM: can we commit to the post-launch dashboard and SLA checks? Need a named owner.

Monica, Karthik — can you confirm the product ETA and whether a rollback/fallback path exists that mitigates customer exposure? Aditya — hold on countersign until we have provisional approval from finance/legal.

If answers are reasonable, I can approve a capped credit (I prefer a $7k cap vs open %).

-Laura
Laura Bennett
VP Commercial
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: timeboxed discount approval for Nimbus routing gap

Laura/Team —

Short answers:
- ETA: Eng confirms GA date target 2027-07-28. We built in a two-week stabilization window; risk of slip is moderate but we have no blocking dependencies that would push past Aug.
- Mitigation: We can surface a prefix-level routing config as interim (manual routing rules) that reduces the customer exposure significantly, but it requires a kickoff with SRE/CS; we estimate 2 weeks to configure and validate.
- Owner: Monica can own the CS validation dashboard; I'll assign an eng lead once we have signoff.

Commercial note: I support a capped credit approach — $7k cap (equivalent to ~two months of the proposed discount) tied to milestone delivery. This keeps us flexible and avoids setting a precedent for open-ended percentage concessions.

I'll add a short statement to the proposed_concession_term.docx to reflect the GA date, milestone acceptance criteria, and credit cap.

Karthik
Director, Product
Redwood Inference

Team — provisional approval granted:
- Approve up to $7,000 in one-time credits applied to the first two invoices, conditional on the milestone language in the attached doc and the GA delivery by 2027-07-30.
- Legal to finalize concession wording; Aditya to hold signature until legal clears.
- Monica to own post-GA validation dashboard and deliver the first report within 10 business days of GA.

Rishi/Aditya: proceed to get written confirmation to Nimbus with the clause. Karthik: please confirm eng lead and update INF-4021 with the hard ETA and risk notes.

-Laura
